headline: Argentina Regulates Anti-Money Laundering Controls for Simplified Tax Regime
summary: Argentina's financial intelligence unit (UIF) established anti-money laundering regulations and controls, enabling taxpayers to deposit previously undeclared savings under a simplified tax regime.
why: Regulatory frameworks governing tax amnesties and capital regularization impact banking compliance and domestic liquidity inflows.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: New compliance guidelines facilitate the formalization of undeclared savings within the banking system.
